description: Spotify desktop player: full-bleed album art, progress bar and playback controls.
name: Spotify Player
settings.accent_color.label: Progress color
settings.accent_color.description: Progress bar color used when cover colors are off. Accepts any theme color or a custom hex.
settings.corner_radius.label: Corner radius
settings.corner_radius.description: Rounding applied to the album art.
settings.hide_when_idle.label: Hide when nothing is playing
settings.hide_when_idle.description: Hide the desktop widget while Spotify is stopped.
settings.show_track_info.label: Show track info
settings.show_track_info.description: Show the track title and artist over the cover.
settings.widget_height.label: Fallback height
settings.widget_height.description: Draw height used only while the widget has no fixed box (auto-fit). Boxed widgets follow the box size.
settings.widget_width.label: Fallback width
settings.widget_width.description: Draw width used only while the widget has no fixed box (auto-fit). Boxed widgets follow the box size.
settings.cover_colors.label: Colors from cover
settings.cover_colors.description: Tint the title, artist, icons and progress bar with the album art hue, contrast-fitted over a soft scrim so they stay readable.
